summary: This staff report examines seven Treasury bonds with maturities beyond the conventional 30-year outer boundary that were issued between 1955 and 1963, including one 40-year bond. The paper analyzes the historical circumstances that led to the issuance of these longer-term instruments during a period before standardized 30-year issuance became the norm in the 1970s.
